_comment: Telegram bot roster for the my-ai gateway. One entry per bot; adding a bot is a JSON edit, no code change. token_env must exist in .secrets (sops) or the bot is skipped at startup. Optional "require_mention": true|false — in group/supergroup chats, gate replies on an @mention, a reply-to-the-bot, or a /command; defaults to true. Direct messages always respond regardless of this flag.
